Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:
If you play a Wash, can you then play another OOT master before your
next Master Phase (like a DI?).

I found this on google:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/742b7f96d40ad4ca?hl=en

(searched on "out of turn wash author:LSJ")

But it doesn't seem to address my question.

My reasoning is:

It seems that the paragraph in Out of Turn masters is pretty explicit,
and I don't see anything on card text of Wash to contradict this
sentence: "You cannot play a second out-of-turn master card before your
next master phase."

So, I think once you play Wash, you cannot play DI or Sudden or any
other OOT master until your next Master phase.

best -

chris

Rulebook 1.6.2

Paragraph 4:
Out-of-turn: You may play an out-of-turn master card whenever
appropriate during another player's turn. Doing so counts against your
next master phase (see Master Phase, sec. 5). You cannot play a second
out-of-turn master card before your next master phase. You cannot play
an out-of-turn master card on your own turn.

Paragraph 5: Trifle: Some master cards are identified as trifles. When a
Methuselah plays a trifle (and it isn't canceled), she gains an
additional master phase action. For an out-of-turn trifle, she gains a
master phase action in her next master phase. A Methuselah can gain only
one master phase action from trifles in a given master phase; others act
like regular master cards.

Wash [Third:U, LotN:PS, KoT:U]
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. Trifle. Do not replace until your next untap phase.
Cancel a master card played by your predator or prey as it is played (no
cost is paid). That Methuselah gains a master phase action (if the
canceled card is an out-of-turn master, the master phase action is
gained during that Methuselah's next master phase).
Artist: Jeremy McHugh
